gold.taskTitle: Research European overnight sleeper train routes
gold.taskDescription: Research available overnight sleeper train routes across Europe to find suitable options for travel.

questions.title: Which city or country are you departing from?
questions.description: Identify the starting point of the journey to narrow down relevant routes.

questions.title: Which destination or region are you hoping to reach?
questions.description: Identify the target destination or region to filter applicable sleeper routes.

questions.title: What are your intended travel dates or timeframe?
questions.description: Determine when the trip is planned to check schedule availability and booking windows.

questions.title: How many people will be travelling on this trip?
questions.description: Know the group size to research appropriate cabin or berth configurations.

questions.title: Do you prefer a private cabin or shared compartment?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred accommodation type to match comfort and budget expectations.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget per person for the train?

questions.title: Is this for a single route or a multi-leg itinerary?
